paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Single vs. multiple platforms as data sources over time. While most of the datasets are collected from a single source, around 2018 researchers are increasingly collecting data from multiple sources (i.e., two or more).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets based on the number of data sources over time. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, with a linear scale and evenly spaced tick labels for each year. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and displays values on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 20. Two sets of bars are present, differentiated by color: a blue bar series representing datasets with one data source and an orange bar series representing datasets with two or more data sources. The blue bars depict values ranging from approximately 5 in 2012 to approximately 85 in 2021, with a general trend of increasing height over the observed years. The orange bars display values ranging from approximately 10 in 2013 to about 50 in 2021. The bars are sorted by year in ascending order, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations.
